rules.text: Review the first corrected framework-only timed cohort preparation. Same previously startup-verified binary, unchanged strict phase/backend/display/pending validators and locked match; no new native build or shipping behavior. 40-second command and 60-second outer deadline, fail first and preserve journals, no unchanged retry. Original 0..2ms phase/0.1ms bridge and all joins remain. Existing Host.finish is integrity assertions; owned executor finally retires children and exclusive lease context releases ownership. Precondition refusal before started.json is intentional admission, proven by real CLI negative check. SIG handlers restored before sealing I/O; rejected run exits nonzero. Current user explicitly authorizes screen for remaining release tests. No cadence/native equivalence or release qualification claim. Full archive locally indexed and verified, excluded binary payload from provider. Archival helper absolute paths disclose local provenance, not advertised universal public CLI. Evaluate concrete runtime, bounds, evidence and test errors; preserve old failed attempts, features and release gate.
